_meta.summary: Fires when the garage_check automation stops running (no root spans in the window) - the dead-automation / dead-battery story.
_meta.production_vs_demo: In production a health automation that hasn't run in 24h is dead: set evalWindow '24h' and stepInterval 86400 (and absentFor ~60). This shipped copy uses a demo-able evalWindow '10m' / stepInterval 600 so it can be fired on camera in ~10-12 min. Only the window/stepInterval/absentFor change between demo and prod - the shape is identical.
_meta.why_single_wide_bucket: CRITICAL: garage_check runs sparsely (every ~2-3 min), so a per-minute count series (stepInterval 60) is full of empty buckets. alertOnAbsent reads those empty minute-buckets as 'absent' and FALSE-FIRES while the automation is perfectly alive (observed: '[No data]' fired with 4 runs in the last 30m). The fix is stepInterval == evalWindow: the count collapses to ONE bucket over the whole window, which is non-empty whenever there is >=1 run in the window, so alertOnAbsent only sees 'absent' when the automation is genuinely silent for the full window.
_meta.how_absence_is_detected: While alive: the single bucket = run count >=1, which does NOT breach 'in total below 1', so no threshold alert. When dead: the trace series goes empty for the whole window; a plain threshold can't compare an empty series, so alertOnAbsent=true fires after absentFor minutes of continuous silence.
_meta.fire_on_demand: Kill the battery so sim_battery_nudge stops and garage_check goes silent: POST /api/services/script/turn_on {"entity_id":"script.kill_garage_battery"} (pins input_number.garage_battery to 0). ~10 min later (window empties) + absentFor the rule fires. Restore with script.restore_garage_battery. (See FIRE-ON-DEMAND.md.)
_meta.op_encoding: op '2' = below; matchType '4' = in total; target 1 => a live automation (>=1 run in window) never breaches; alertOnAbsent handles the dead case.

annotations.description: The garage_check automation has not produced a run in the evaluation window. In the seeded house this means the garage battery hit 0, the simulator stopped nudging it, and the health check silently died - exactly the 'automation just stopped and nobody noticed' failure Home APM exists to catch. Demo window: 10m. Production value: evalWindow 24h.
